positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Used: Python, PHP, React, Javascript, Docker, AWS, DynamoDB
-Spearhead development of features for business lending platform utilizing Python, React, and PHP, enhancing user experience and efficiency.
-Collaborate with data science team to automate internal processes by integrating predictions models which improved workflow and productivity, cutting review time up to 25% per loan application.
-Transitioned legacy PHP code to Python repositories, optimizing codebase for scalability and maintainability.
-Won company AI hackathon by creating a fully working prototype using OpenAI’s API to create test data in our lower environments for engineers/product managers to test features and bugs.
